$comment: The one source for every colour terva's web surfaces draw. packages/agent/web/client/src/ui/tokens.css is generated from this file; run `just design-tokens` after an edit and commit both. docs/design-system.md explains the layers.

brand.$comment: The brand pigments. The landing page (docs/vanity/site/index.html) declares each as --<key>, and the palette table in assets/brand/README.md lists the named ones. packages/testsupport checks both copies against this file.

deep-tar.name: Deep Tar
deep-tar.use: App icon background, code wells, app dark ground

charcoal-2.use: A deeper card for alternate landing-page sections

ink.use: Dimmed birch, body text on tar

faint.use: Lockup rule and tagline, fine print

panel.$comment: The control panel. Each scheme role is declared once per scheme as --c-<role>-light and --c-<role>-dark. styles.css points --<role> at one of them, so the scheme switch re-maps tokens and never restates a colour.

shared.$comment: Scheme-independent. --warning is the step between fine and wrong. --hover is a neutral wash for a hovered or picked row, and a grey at this alpha reads on either ground.

stage.$comment: Stage's presets. Dusk is the base, emitted as :root, and declares every role. Each other preset is emitted as :root[data-theme='<name>'] and declares only what it changes, so it inherits the rest from Dusk.

parchment.$comment: The one light preset. Its accent is a mid-brown that near-black text sits at about 3:1 against, so it overrides --stage-on-accent with light text.
